response.reason: The quoted clause (definition of 'legal name' in Art. 2(2)(n)) only defines what a 'legal name' is; it does not establish the requirement to provide a legal name, nor does it address the requirement for QUID (quantitative ingredient declaration) for ingredients appearing in the name. The verdict turns on compliance with the QUID requirement under Art. 22(1), which is not contained in this clause. Therefore, this clause is insufficient to ground the verdict.
